result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poor, featuring a narrow sidewalk that is significantly obstructed by concrete barriers and overgrown vegetation. The roadway is wide with no visible lane markings or pedestrian crossing infrastructure, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.description: Large concrete Jersey barriers are placed directly on or adjacent to the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or overgrown areas.

hazards.name: Poor Walkway Condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface appears cracked and is being encroached upon by weeds and debris.

hazards.description: A wide, unmarked roadway with no designated crossing points increases risk for pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire foreground roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Repair
interventions.description: Remove the concrete barriers and clear overgrown vegetation to restore the full width of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Roadway Markings
interventions.description: Apply standard lane markings to organize vehicle flow and reduce the perceived width of the street, which can help lower vehicle speeds.

result.summary: This residential intersection features row houses with sidewalks on both sides, but lacks marked pedestrian crossings or ADA-compliant curb ramps. While stop signs are present to control vehicle traffic, the wide, unmarked roadway and absence of traffic calming measures create a less-than-ideal environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, making pedestrian crossing points less visible to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No visible ADA-compliant curb ramps at the corners, creating barriers for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poor, featuring a severely degraded and overgrown sidewalk that is partially obstructed by concrete barriers. result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks, crosswalks, or any dedicated pedestrian infrastructure. The wide, unmarked roadway and the presence of concrete barriers suggest a high-speed, vehicle-oriented corridor with no safe space for walking.

hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or designated walking paths, forcing pedestrians to share the roadway with vehicles or walk on unpaved, uneven grass behind concrete barriers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by concrete barriers and overgrown vegetation that obstruct the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the roadway. The presence of a large vacant lot creates a long blank frontage, reducing natural surveillance and comfort for walkers.
